title: [Forecast quý 2/2025] The level of satisfaction of the health care system
prompt: The line graph shows the level of satisfaction of the health care system in four countries in three years. Summarize the information by reporting the main features, and making comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the proportion of people satisfied with the healthcare system in four different countries across three time periods: 1991, 1998, and 2007.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the countries displayed distinct patterns, with Canada experiencing dramatic fluctuations while the other nations showed more gradual trends. Canada began with the highest satisfaction rate but ended in the middle range by 2007, whereas the US consistently recorded the lowest levels throughout the period.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Canada initially led with 60% satisfaction in 1991, significantly higher than the Netherlands at 48%. However, Canada's figure plummeted dramatically to a trough of 19% in 1998, before recovering substantially to 40% by 2007. In contrast, the Netherlands maintained relatively stable levels throughout the period, with figures rising slightly from 48% to 49% in 1998, then declining to 47% in 2007.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: The UK and US started with considerably lower rates at 22% and 10% respectively in 1991. The UK demonstrated gradual improvement, rising steadily from 22% to 25% in 1998, and continuing to 28% by 2007. Similarly, the US showed modest but consistent growth from 10% to 11% in 1998, reaching 12% by 2007, though it remained the least satisfied country throughout all three years.
